entry.title: Resolution 526 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR ONE MULTIFUNCTION COPY MACHINE TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF THE COUNTY AUDITOR

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an estimated annual cost of $2,000, to be used by department personnel in Hilo.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 526-26 - 04/22/26
